limitations: Auto-KV block-count drift causes partial cache reuse and main serving-graph recompilation; no cache-key validation was bypassed.
One startup per case; small differences do not establish statistically significant speedups.
Host cadence is not device capacity or client request throughput. Whole-encoder windows include first/tail boundary work.
Device profile uses six complete rank-0 encoder graphs, each with 20 MoE calls; truncated graphs are excluded.
Startup-to-health includes weight loading and warmup. Logged compilation is not pure XLA compile time.
Large allocated KV is preserved; this is not a full-capacity concurrency stress test or long-generation accuracy qualification.
Full-runtime type checking retains 61 baseline diagnostics. TPU CI requires the maintainer ready label.
